source_phrase: The maximum length of a name is 63 characters.
At least one digit in a label shall be nonzero.
A scalar-int-constant-name shall be a named constant of type integer.
The value of kind-param shall be nonnegative.
If both kind-param and exponent-letter appear, exponent-letter shall be E.
The int-literal-constant shall not include a kind-param.
digit shall have one of the values 0 or 1.
digit shall have one of the values 0 through 7.
